name: review
description: Evidence-backed code review, read-only review claim verification, and pull request review responses.

interface.longDescription: Completion-gated code review that inventories every changed file, routes stack specialists, and promotes only evidence-backed findings with exact file:line placement. Also answers reviews on your own pull requests with verified fixes and in-thread replies. Checks existing review claims without editing code or posting replies with review-check.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review the current changes and report evidence-backed findings.
